stories.title: Gasly's Sensational Maiden Pole at Monza — Alpine's Greatest Qualifying Shock

x_posts.label: Post 1-1
x_posts.text:
Pierre Gasly just took his FIRST career F1 pole at Monza.

1:21.786 — 0.060s ahead of Russell. Piastri third.

First French F1 pole at Monza since Jean Alesi in 1997.

This was NOT supposed to happen. 🏆 #F1 #ItalianGP

x_posts.label: Post 1-2
x_posts.text:
Pierre Gasly. Pole. Monza. 2026.

Alpine hasn't had a pole since they rebranded from Renault.

Russell P2. Piastri P3. Leclerc P4. Hamilton P5. Antonelli starts LAST.

What a qualifying session. #F1 #ItalianGP #Alpine

article.headline: Pierre Gasly Claims Maiden F1 Pole at Monza — First French Pole at the Temple of Speed Since 1997

stories.title: Hamilton's Ferrari Dream at the Temple of Speed

x_posts.label: Post 5
x_posts.text:
Lewis Hamilton has NEVER won the Italian Grand Prix.

Today he started P5 at Monza — in a Ferrari — on the Schumacher tribute weekend.

The circuit Schumacher won 5 times. The suits. The cars on display.

All that's missing is a Hamilton victory. #F1 #Ferrari #ItalianGP
